name: @r16t/multimodal-mcp

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt using AI. Available providers: none configured

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate

provider.description: Provider to use: openai, xai, google. Auto-selects if omitted.

outputDirectory.description: Directory to save the generated file. Supports absolute or relative paths (resolved from cwd). Defaults to MEDIA_OUTPUT_DIR env var or cwd.

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Edit an existing image using AI. Provide the path to an image and a text prompt describing the desired edits. Available providers: none configured

imagePath.description: Absolute path to the source image file to edit

prompt.description: Text description of the edits to apply to the image

provider.description: Provider to use: openai, xai, google. Auto-selects if omitted.

outputDirectory.description: Directory to save the edited file. Supports absolute or relative paths (resolved from cwd). Defaults to MEDIA_OUTPUT_DIR env var or cwd.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Generate a video from a text prompt using AI. Optionally provide an image as the first frame. Available providers: none configured

prompt.description: Text description of the video to generate

provider.description: Provider to use: openai, xai, google. Auto-selects if omitted.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds (provider limits apply)

imagePath.description: Path to an image to use as the first frame of the video (OpenAI and Google only)

outputDirectory.description: Directory to save the generated file. Supports absolute or relative paths (resolved from cwd). Defaults to MEDIA_OUTPUT_DIR env var or cwd.

tools.name: generate_audio
tools.description: Generate audio (text-to-speech) from text using AI. Available providers: none configured

provider.description: Provider to use: openai, google. Auto-selects if omitted.

voice.description: Voice name (provider-specific). OpenAI: alloy, ash, coral, echo, fable, nova, onyx, sage, shimmer. Google: Kore, Charon, Fenrir, Aoede, Puck, etc.

format.description: Output format (OpenAI only): mp3, opus, aac, flac, wav, pcm

outputDirectory.description: Directory to save the generated file. Supports absolute or relative paths (resolved from cwd). Defaults to MEDIA_OUTPUT_DIR env var or cwd.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List all configured media generation providers and their capabilities
